label: prop:mass-identity-unique
title: Uniqueness of the inertial mass identity
html:
Given a fixed quantum observable universe (quantum observable universe) (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) and a fixed closed cycle \varrho \colon \mathbf{1} \to A, the scalar ambiguity of the Frobenius pairing uniquely determines the inertial mass \mathfrak{m}(\varrho) (uniqueness of Frobenius pairing). Specifically, if \int_A^{(1)} = c \int_A^{(2)}, then \mathfrak{m}_{(1)}(\varrho) = |c| \cdot \mathfrak{m}_{(2)}(\varrho).

Once we fix a normalisation for \int_A, the mass function \mathfrak{m} \colon \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}, A) \to R is unique.
heading: Proposition
